items.title: ExileCon 2026 Twitch Drops
items.summary: Tune in to the ExileCon livestream this weekend to catch our latest developments for Path of Exile 1 and Path of Exile 2 and claim a new set of Twitch Drops! Read this news post for all the details.

items.title: ExileCon 2026 - House Rules and Event Streaming Code of Conduct
items.summary: For attendees and streamers who would like to share the ExileCon experience with viewers unable to attend in person, we've put together a Code of Conduct outlining guidelines for livestreaming and appropriate behaviour during the event. If you plan to livestream from ExileCon, please follow the guidelines outlined in today's news post to help ensure the event remains fun and safe for everyone.

items.title: ExileCon 2026 Schedule and Information for Attendees
items.summary: The schedule for ExileCon 2026, starting in just a week, is now available! Check out the convention website to find out more about the full programme for next weekend. In this news post, we’ve also included some useful information that our attendees might need.
